title: Gospel participle clusters
subtitle: Keep the main action standing while details accumulate.
overview: A cluster of participles can frame time, manner, cause, or accompanying action around one finite verb.
Parse each participle separately, but translate only after you can state how it attaches to the main event.

items.grc: καὶ ἐλθὼν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἰδὼν αὐτὸν σπλαγχνισθεὶς ἐπέδησεν τὰ τραύματα αὐτοῦ.
items.en: And coming to him, seeing him, and being moved with compassion, he bound up his wounds.

items.grc: λαβὼν τοὺς πέντε ἄρτους ἀναβλέψας εὐλόγησεν.
items.en: Taking the five loaves and looking up, he blessed them.
